censusScope: Every tracked ARCHIVE-MANIFEST/SOURCE-MANIFEST under docs/, found by git ls-files and checked against the declared tuple on every run; canonical copies are searched across all of docs/ because two waves land inside their own docs/taskpacks directory.
digestSource: git cat-file blob HEAD:<path> (never the worktree: core.autocrlf makes a checked-out file differ from the committed bytes)

It is not "the material does not exist" and it is not a pass.
